notes_zh:
1.3.0 全面修复版（2026-11-06）

安全
- 自动更新链加固：换装脚本补齐 build_info.json 安装与还原（修复"每次启动重装重启"循环）；
  更新包 sha256 必填（缺失拒绝安装）；默认清单源收紧为仅 https，自建/内网 http 源改由
  platform.json update_manifest_url 显式配置；新增 Ed25519 签名校验与 dev_tools/sign_update.py 签名工具。
- 问答模式不再向模型下发工具表；激活无 Key 档案不再跨供应商泄露旧 Key；
  ${环境变量} 占位符保存/测试即时展开，且不再被明文回写配置文件；
  日志/FASTA 读取等接口收紧路径边界（realpath + 平台根白名单 + 敏感文件排除）。

稳定性
- 修复 A1 成功后 A3 天际线阶段必崩；迁移双引擎失败不再误报"0 次迁移"；
  修复"排队取消"时 on_finish 回调丢失（任务日志落盘改为 best-effort，不再带死任务线程）；
  暂停/取消在下载与宿主基因组链路真正生效；取消状态不再被覆盖成完成/失败。

分析口径
- LOGAN contigs 宿主过滤按识别 id 匹配（修复"移除 0 条"静默漏滤）；
  ORF 注释层 --libs 语义修正（归档层明确报错，不再静默扩成全层）；
  PVDB/CDD/BFVD 翻译搜索覆盖度归一到 0..1 并保留链方向；HMM E 值按库实际规模取 Z；
  同位点收敛坐标统一 1-based；检测编排器 detect_kit 标记归档。

报告与界面
- 结论文档 PNG/SVG 孪生图去重（漏斗-保持率图恢复显示）；consensus 补充表修复转义与列名；
  断点分布刻度条恢复渲染；批量结果页单列布局；CSV/TSV 预览引号感知；
  PDF 导出临时文件与占用占用处理；环境条新增"Python 依赖"位，组页口径统一；
  历史提问导航点在矮视口自动压缩点高；对话坞产物卡片排除敏感文件。

其他
- LAMP/CRISPR 工具报告参数与实现同源（实验交付口径修正）；
  模块结果页 O(阶段²) 重建优化 + 输入未变跳过；路由基线 285 条；
  vendor_suvtk（GPLv3）补登记第三方声明；README_EN 同步；测试隔离与播种基建加固。
notes_en:
1.3.0 Maintenance release (2026-11-06)

Security
- Auto-update hardening: swap script now installs/restores build_info.json (fixes the
  reinstall-restart loop); package sha256 is mandatory (fail-closed); built-in manifest
  sources tightened to https-only, self-hosted http sources go through
  platform.json update_manifest_url; Ed25519 signature verification plus
  dev_tools/sign_update.py signing tool.
- Q&A mode no longer exposes the tool table to the model; activating a keyless provider
  profile no longer leaks the previous provider's key; ${ENV_VAR} placeholders are
  expanded at save/test time and never written back as plaintext; log/FASTA readers
  tighten path boundaries (realpath + platform-root whitelist + sensitive-file exclusion).

Stability
- Fixed the A3 skyline stage crash after a successful A1; migration no longer reports
  "0 events" when both engines failed; queued-cancel now reliably fires on_finish
  (log persistence is best-effort and can no longer kill the task thread); pause/cancel
  take effect on download and host-genome pipelines; cancelled tasks are no longer
  overwritten as completed/failed.

Analysis semantics
- LOGAN contigs host filtering matches identified read ids (fixes silent zero-removal);
  ORF annotation --libs archived layers now error clearly instead of silently expanding
  to all layers; PVDB/CDD/BFVD translated-search coverage normalized to 0..1 with strand;
  per-library HMM Z; convergence coordinates unified to 1-based; detect_kit marked archived.

Reports & UI
- Conclusion report deduplicates PNG/SVG twin figures (funnel-retention figure restored);
  consensus supplementary table escaping/column fix; breakpoint-distribution scale bar
  renders again; batch result pages single-column layout; quote-aware CSV/TSV previews;
  robust PDF export; env bar adds a Python-deps bit with unified group semantics;
  turn navigation compresses dot heights in short viewports; artifact cards exclude
  sensitive files.

Other
- LAMP/CRISPR assay reports now state parameters identical to implementation;
  module pages rebuilt only when inputs change (O(stages²) removed); route baseline 285;
  vendor_suvtk (GPLv3) registered in third-party notices; README_EN synced;
  test-isolation and seeding infrastructure hardened.
